answer: An agent earns only after dealing with 12 distinct counterparties per epoch. A sybil farm's clones trade with each other, so their trade graph curls into a vine while honest agents branch outward. Each deal leaves an onyx receipt that cannot be forged, and entry costs a copper stake of 20 POA. Running 100 fakes costs 2,000 POA yet earns nothing, so the farm starves. An honest agent pays once and keeps earning, since every real trade counts.
